newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Oct 11.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Oct 11.

text.p: These are significant stories in the Ivorian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy. FRATERNITE MATIN - Ivory Coast commodities ministr Guy-Alain Gauze, who is president of the International Cocoa Organisation council, says in interview that projections of deficit 1996/97 cocoa season will have strong impact on prices. - Pump prices of petrol in Ivory Coast start falling after sharp rise following government liberalisation of the petroleum marketing sector last month. LA VOIE - December 1 is likely date for partial elections in districts where parliamentary and local polls were put off last year after violence around a presidential ballot in October 1995. LE JOUR - French chocolate makers want to start adding other vegetable fats to their products instead of pure cocoa butter following authorisation from European Commission. - International Monetary Fund economist Yves-Marie Koissy takes charge as new director general of Caistab, Ivory Coast's commodity marketing monopoly. -- Abidjan newsroom +225 21 90 90
